xna-type.name: GameDefaults
xna-type.remarks: Wherever possible, games should default to the values specified in GameDefaults .

property.name: AccelerateWithButtons
property.summary: Gets whether the gamer prefers to use controller buttons to accelerate in racing games.
property.value: true if the gamer prefers to use controller buttons to accelerate in racing games; false otherwise. If false, use triggers for acceleration.

property.name: AutoAim
property.summary: Gets whether the title should automatically correct the gamer's aim.
property.value: true if the title should automatically correct the gamer's aim; false otherwise.

property.name: AutoCenter
property.summary: Gets whether the title should automatically center the view when the gamer moves.
property.value: true if the title should automatically center the view when the gamer moves; false otherwise.

property.name: BrakeWithButtons
property.summary: Gets whether the gamer prefers to use controller buttons to brake in racing games.
property.value: true if the gamer prefers to use controller buttons to brake in racing games; false otherwise. If false, use the triggers for braking.

property.name: ControllerSensitivity
property.summary: Gets the preferred controller sensitivity setting for this gamer.
property.value: The preferred controller sensitivity setting for this gamer.

property.name: GameDifficulty
property.summary: Gets the preferred difficulty setting for this gamer.
property.value: The preferred difficulty setting for this gamer.

property.name: InvertYAxis
property.summary: Gets whether the gamer prefers to invert the y-axis input of the controller.
property.value: true if the gamer prefers to invert the y-axis input of the controller; false otherwise.

property.name: ManualTransmission
property.summary: Gets whether the gamer prefers to drive a manual shift transmission in racing games.
property.value: true if the gamer prefers to drive a manual shift transmission in racing games; false otherwise.

property.name: MoveWithRightThumbStick
property.summary: Gets whether the gamer prefers to move using the right thumbstick.
property.value: true if the gamer prefers to move using the right thumbstick; false otherwise. If this value is false, use the left thumbstick for player movement.

property.name: PrimaryColor
property.summary: Gets the preferred color for the player character.
property.value: The preferred color for the player character.

property.name: RacingCameraAngle
property.summary: Gets the gamer's preferred camera angle for racing games.
property.value: The gamer's preferred camera angle for racing games.

property.name: SecondaryColor
property.summary: Gets a secondary color selection for the player character.
property.value: A secondary color selection for the player character.
